title: B1.11 frost hydraulic modifier migration
protocol: RECONCILE -> SOURCE TRACE -> PHYSICAL REVIEW -> IMPLEMENT -> LOCAL O0/O2 -> TRANSACTION/RESTART/PRESERVATION -> QUALIFY -> ADMIT OR CLOSE GAPS
bounded_scope: typed temperature-to-rfcp calculation with finite, ordered thresholds
constitutive conductivity scaling and matching dK/dh
reuse of existing sensible-temperature state, transaction and restart
preserve theta(h), C(h), storage and mass owners
preserve all frost-off Richards and sensible-temperature behavior
held_scope: FrozenBounds legacy drainage/top/bottom heuristic rejected in current form; a future typed boundary replacement requires separate contract and mass qualification
binary frost root stress rejected in current form for this migration; any replacement requires separate biological contract and sink-chain qualification
latent heat, ice content or unfrozen-water relation as new physics
oracle_matrix: K and dK/dh relation including legacy residual floor
rejected trial and retry use committed temperature only
restart rebuilds factor from existing temperature profile

runtime_matrix_evidence.retry_case: partial frost with 1e-10 cm/day prescribed top flux, zero prescribed bottom flux, external full/half temporal policy
runtime_matrix_evidence.direct_comparison: eight consecutive 1.25e-5 day runs from the same initial physical checkpoint versus one retried 1e-4 day run
runtime_matrix_evidence.qualification_note: State-comparison tolerances were formalized after the exploratory transaction case was identified; they are explicit replay-oracle limits, not a claim of preregistration before that observation.

invariants: candidate/rejected frost result never mutates committed state
K and dK/dh use the same candidate frost factor
no new water mass or energy owner
qualification_gate: Local focused and transaction tests first; GitHub Actions only if a persisted current-canonical qualification/admission result is required.
